And it will be best to listen as you soon rest your head in a bed of flowers.|audio = VoidcoreWave48-4.ogg|'''Void Caster''' on Wave 48 of [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode}} }} ==Description== The '''Void Caster''' is a narrator who appears in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. She has two variants, the first is the regular variant referred to in-game as ''Void Caster'' and a silhouette variant, referred to as ''???''. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Animated |{{Tabber |Regular |The '''Void Caster''' has a black body, purple eyes and purple hair. She wears a purple and black robe with flowers on it, black shirt, purple pants, purple shoes and black gloves. She has purple horns on its head and a halo floating above it. She carries a staff and a spell book in its hands. |Silhouette |The '''Void Caster''' body is entirely covered in darkness. She wears a robe with flowers on it, shirt, pants, shoes and gloves. She has horns on its head and a halo floating above it. She carries a staff and a spell book in its hands. }} |Icon |The '''Void Caster''' had light pink skin and purple hair. She had neon pink eyes and horns. She wore black shoes, pants, shirt and gloves. Her black clothing also had small neon pink accents. She also wore a purple skirt. In some of her icons, she also held a book, which had a black and purple cover with a few neon pink crystals on it. The pages themselves were seemingly empty. }} ==Animations/Icons== ===Animations=== {{Tabber |Regular |{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table pad-5 align-center" style{{=}}"width:95%; margin: 0 auto" !Neutral !Proud !Aggressive |- |[[File:VoidCasterNeutral.gif|175px]] |[[File:VoidCasterProud.gif|175px]] |[[File:VoidCasterAggressive.gif|175px]] |} }} |Silhouette |{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table pad-5 align-center" style{{=}}"width:95%; margin: 0 auto" !Neutral !Proud !Aggressive |- |[[File:VoidCasterHiddenNeutral.gif|175px]] |[[File:VoidCasterHiddenProud.gif|175px]] |[[File:VoidCasterHiddenAggressive.gif|175px]] |} }} }} ===Icons=== {| class="article-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:95%; margin: 0 auto" !Default !Laugh !Aggressive !Challenge !Command |- |[[File:VoidCasterReading.png|150px]] |[[File:VoidCasterLaugh.png|150px]] |[[File:VoidCasterFurious.png|150px]] |[[File:VoidCasterChallenge.png|150px]] |[[File:VoidCasterCommand.png|150px]] |- !Depressed !Chant |- |[[File:VoidCasterDepressed.png|150px]] |[[File:VoidCasterSpellCast.png|150px]] |} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} After-live-event-thumbnail-aug-2020.png|'''Void Caster''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} VoidCasterPI.jpg|'''Void Caster''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidCasterCA.jpg|'''Void Caster''' on concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} AcceleratorRender.png|'''Void Caster''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} HardcoreBadge.png|'''Void Caster''' on the "Beat Hardcore Beta" badge. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Caster''' being cut is also likely the reason for there initially being two [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]s. *Due to the public test starting the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode match at Wave 49 while only giving the players {{Money|600}}, only '''Void Caster''' dialogue from Wave 49 could be seen. The dialogue was: {| class="wikitable" style="width:80%; text-align: center; margin: 0 auto;" ! class="align-center" colspan="2"|Dialogue |- |[[File:VoidCasterReading.png|100px]] |You definitely are a strong opponent.. |- | style="width:100px;" |[[File:VoidCasterReading.png|100px]] |Im{{sic}} surprised that you've made it this far.. |- | style="width:100px;" |[[File:VoidCasterChallenge.png|100x100px]] |Let's see if you can take this! |- | style="width:100px;" |[[File:VoidCasterCommand.png|100px]] |Stealtheir{{sic}} souls!! |} *The '''Void Caster''' eventually returned when the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode rework launched on the 5th of June 2026. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Caster''' added. {{NarratorNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Void Caster}}
